Attachments: QBR_onepager_template_v3.xlsx (template) — please use this format.

I'll coordinate exec readout slots after we have the consolidated deck. Ping me if capacity issues.

—Vanessa

CloudScale (DEAL-4892) — 5-bullet surface:
- Deal size: $1.2M ARR initial; 12-month reserved Dedicated plan.
- Value proposition: Reduce inference unit cost by ~40% for their retraining pipeline; need predictable latency for 99th pct tail.
- Current blockers: 1) Legal review of data residency clause (EU region), 2) performance SLO definition for 4ms p50 target on private deployment.
- Next milestone: Tech due diligence call with their infra leads on May 13; legal to confirm addendum by May 20.
- Upside/contingency: If we accept an SLO tiered pricing band, we can accelerate signature by 4 weeks.

Acme Corp (renewal) — key points:
- Renewal value: $460k ARR; in year 2 with add-on for private license.
- Blockers: procurement timing and PO approval; they requested expanded audit log retention.
- Next milestone: procurement sends redlines by May 11 (they looped procurement@acme-corp.com).

I'll coordinate with Karhik on the sensitivity table — initial numbers attached inline.

Vanessa / Markus —

Sensitivity snapshot (high level):
- Baseline: CloudScale recognized in Q3 if we close by May 31 => +$300k recognized in Q3, remaining recognized over FY28.
- If CloudScale slips 30 days: recognition shifts ~1 quarter => Q3 down by $300k; forecast accuracy delta = -18% for the QBR pipeline target.
- If CloudScale slips 60 days: compresses recognition into Q4 with increased pressure on next-quarter bookings to meet OKR.

Suggested mitigations:
- Offer a short-term pilot with a capped usage credit to accelerate legal/procurement sign-off (reduces revenue but preserves recognition timing).
- Tiered SLO pricing to decouple full commit from performance guarantees.

I'll add a concise table and scenario rows into the shared deck (column headers: scenario, delta_Q3_recognition, mitigation_cost_estimate). Draft will be in the drive by 5pm PST.

—Karthik
